description: This course introduces the core principles and technologies of artificial intelligence, covering machine learning algorithms such as linear regression, decision trees, and neural networks; natural language processing techniques like word2vec and BERT; search algorithms including A* and Dijkstra's; knowledge representation using ontologies and semantic web standards; and ethical considerations in AI. Students will explore AI frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch; evaluate performance metrics like accuracy and F1 score; and understand AI standards such as ISO/IEC 24028. The course emphasizes hands-on implementation of AI models and their real-world applications in domains such as cybersecurity and healthcare.

clos.text: Define key concepts in artificial intelligence, including machine learning, natural language processing, and knowledge representation.
Describe the architecture and implementation of neural networks using frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch.
Explain search algorithms such as A* and Dijkstra's and their applications in pathfinding and optimization problems.
Apply machine learning algorithms to real-world datasets using Python and evaluate their performance using metrics like accuracy and F1 score.
Design and implement AI systems that adhere to ethical standards and industry guidelines such as ISO/IEC 24028.

labs: Implement linear regression for regression tasks
Implement decision trees and random forests for classification

topics: Neural Networks and Deep Learning Basics
labs: Build a simple neural network using TensorFlow
Tokenize and preprocess text data using spaCy
Implement word2vec and fine-tune BERT for text classification
Implement A* and Dijkstra's algorithm for grid pathfinding
Create a simple ontology using OWL and RDF

topics: Ethical AI and Bias Mitigation Techniques
labs: Analyze bias in datasets and implement fairness-aware models
Compute accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score for models

topics: AI in Cybersecurity and Healthcare Applications
labs: Implement intrusion detection using supervised learning
Review ISO/IEC 24028 standards and compliance checks
Present and defend AI project implementation
